Both the start and the end have note 3.
Case 1: If the start is 3, note 3 is removed from the cells that see the start.
경우 2: 처음은 3과 7뿐이라, 3이 아니면 7입니다.\n다음 칸은 7:
Case 2: The start has only 3 and 7, so if it isn't 3, it is 7.
The next cell isn't 7, and the one after it is 7.
So the end isn't 7, and with only 3 and 7, it is 3.
Then note 3 is removed
from the cells that see the end.
Either way, the start
or the end is 3.
So remove note 3 from every cell
that sees both the start and the end.
